test_conditions.note: Results were measured on PAN-OS 12.2. Scale numbers and capacity limits vary across software releases and may change over time as new features and capabilities are introduced.

fw_throughput_appmix_mbps.label: Firewall throughput (appmix)
test_conditions: Firewall throughput is measured with App-ID and logging enabled, by using appmix transactions.

threat_prevention_throughput_mbps.label: Threat Prevention throughput (appmix)
test_conditions: Threat Prevention throughput is measured with App-ID, IPS, antivirus, antispyware, WildFire, file blocking, and logging enabled, by using appmix transactions.

ipsec_throughput_mbps.label: IPsec VPN throughput
test_conditions: IPsec VPN throughput is measured with 64 KB HTTP transactions and logging enabled.

concurrent_sessions.label: Max concurrent sessions
test_conditions: Maximum concurrent sessions are measured by using HTTP transactions.

new_sessions_per_sec.label: New sessions per second
test_conditions: New sessions per second is measured with application override, by using 1-byte HTTP transactions.

vsys_base.label: Virtual systems (base/max)
test_conditions: Adding virtual systems over the base quantity requires a separately purchased license. An active/active NGFW cluster supports a maximum of 25 virtual systems.

vsys_max.label: Virtual systems (base/max)
test_conditions: Adding virtual systems over the base quantity requires a separately purchased license. An active/active NGFW cluster supports a maximum of 25 virtual systems.
